behavior_contracts.BC14: Bound standard catches in ordinary call/chain matches and shared/per-entry coordination handlers bind the opaque standard_failure snapshot; kind/message/occurrence_id project through adapters. Unbound [_] still catches without binding. No str binder alias remains.
behavior_contracts.BC15: One standard occurrence observed through an ordinary catch and re-observed through an aggregate leaf (constructed all_failed or runtime aggregate, which stores the exact snapshot object) retains occurrence_id, kind, and message; repeated projections allocate nothing.

compiler/internal/emit/regions.go: standard arm binds completion.value (the snapshot object) instead of the canonical message string; opaque emits as unknown with branded adapter casts at projection sites.
compiler/internal/emit/regions.go + program.go: removed the now-unused $canStandardMessage import; projection adapters ($canFailureKind/Message/OccurrenceID) already imported.

runtime/failure.test.ts: hostile object gains valueOf + Symbol.toPrimitive traps; throwing-toString Error still describes via descriptors; invoked stays 0.

exit_mapping.integration: Argument-failure boundaries (emit lookup(1/0) cases, arrays standard_stop/nonfinite_sort), handler-failure escape (runtime coordination.test.ts handler test inside the bundled run; check-level handler region tests), sticky harness recovery (TestAssertionFailureLocations + runtime assert suites), and supervised timeouts (LF04 suites) all green. Timeout remains a supervisor result, outside catches.
exit_mapping.negative: str binders reject with snapshot diagnostic (order test); snapshot construction (no eligible declaration), emits occurrence (ineligible bound), wire encode (not codec-admissible), and copy-update (unknown field / record-or-error only) reject (TestStandardSnapshotContracts); Proxy/getter/throwing-toString/valueOf/Symbol.toPrimitive traps never execute (invoked==0); forged lookalikes fail isStandardFailure and projection accessors throw.
exit_mapping.positive: Ordinary catch + aggregate leaf report identical occurrence_id/kind/message for one occurrence (TestStandardSnapshotIdentity, executed + strict tsc); projections type-check (int/str/str); snapshots store in locals/records/variants and narrow in data matches; exact legacy message texts preserved via .message.
